interpretations.statement: Unreviewed interpretation: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] Selected control: eligibility for removal of prior SFC approval for a material UCITS investment change outside the legacy-application transition. Within the stated scope, true means the change meets the circular's stated home-compliance condition and none of its stated exceptions applies. False means this removal is unavailable under those conditions; it does not independently establish a prohibition, non-compliance or the complete underlying approval obligation. Outside scope, the result supplies no determination. Unknown facts remain unknown.
